description: Use this when someone asks if they are Manglik or have Mangal dosha. Returns where Mars falls from the rising sign, the Moon and Venus. Present it honestly: about half of all charts count as Manglik by the common rule, so it is common, not a danger. Needs the birth time.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

name: manglik_check
title: Manglik (Mangal dosha) check
